description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget and related screens for a Flutter mobile application, including UI components, navigation, and data fetching logic for tips, fitness plans, meal plans, recommended products, and AI feeding support.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main home screen widget showing greeting, feature cards, and tips list.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen managing data fetching and UI updates.

classes.name: _FitnessPlanScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying a list of fitness plan items.

classes.name: _FitnessPlanScreenState
classes.description: State class handling data fetch and UI for FitnessPlan screen.

classes.name: _MealPlansScreen
classes.description: Screen displaying a list of meal plans.

classes.name: _MealPlansScreenState
classes.description: State class handling fetch and UI for MealPlanning screen.

classes.name: _ProductsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing fetch and display of products.

classes.name: _AiFeedingScreen
classes.description: Screen for AI feeding support, allowing user to ask questions.

classes.name: _AiFeedingScreenState
classes.description: State class handling user interaction and API calls for AI feeding support.

methods.name: _fetchTips
methods.description: Fetches tips from API and updates the UI.

methods.name: _ask
methods.description: Sends a question to the AI API and displays the answer.
